claims.statement: Explorer, headless reports, and PR compare are equally important consumers; one shared metric definition should drive all three.
Work happens now as a stack of PRs: fix issues first, then improve the system.
All four research initiatives are in scope now, not gated behind each other.
Cut boldly: remove misleading risk directions and noisy metrics now, with no compatibility layer.
The agent runs the portfolio pilot itself on local repos and adjudicates cases; Byron is minimally available. Use consider-contrast for consequential choices.
Must have an excellent single-metric hotspot list. Add a two-axis scatter with a named 2x2 quadrant model.
Keep React/TSX-specific metrics that help target React and TSX refactors; choose the set by consider-contrast instead of deleting them all.
Excessive comments matter now (AI-era over-commenting); the low-comments penalty is the wrong direction. TODOs are low priority.
Srcly must just work: run lint/type tools itself with no bespoke config, rather than import user-supplied artifacts. Lint/type findings are in scope.
Ship several named 2x2 scatter presets (e.g. activity, blast radius, React component weight, comment noise) rather than one fixed pair.
Excessive comments = high comment ratio, docblocks much longer than the body, and commented-out code, judged against absolute thresholds, never the repo norm.
Findings use project tsc/eslint when present, otherwise Srcly bundled defaults (ruff for Python, built-in tree-sitter rules for TS), labelled by which ran.

Stack order confirmed: trust fixes, catalog cuts + comment flip, single-metric list + shared definitions, Git activity on by default, 2x2 presets, findings, local-repo pilot. Clones and coverage below the cut line.

shape.problem: Metrics conflate zero with N/A, rank inconsistently across surfaces, score some fields in the wrong direction, and lack activity/comment-noise/component/finding signals.
shape.recommended_shape: Trust fixes, one server-owned catalog, bold cuts plus comment-noise and component metrics, single-metric list, Git activity, 2x2 presets, zero-config findings, agent-run pilot.
success_moves: Trust before signals so new data is not read as zero
Single server catalog removes three hand-mirrored tables
Reuse compare git_refs runner for activity
External tools behind one runner with timeout -> N/A
Absolute comment thresholds tuned by pilot
Agent-run hybrid pilot replaces human-gated review

closure.summary: The metric system overhaul landed as seven stacked PRs: trust fixes, catalog cuts with comment noise and component metrics, one server-owned catalog with a single-metric list, Git activity, 2x2 presets, zero-config findings, and a four-repo pilot that tuned the defaults.
evidence: M7 pilot: 729 cases adjudicated on srcly, recipes-modern, explorEDA and context-recorder (docs/research/metric-pilot-2026-10/README.md, cases.tsv).
cd server && uv run pytest: 344 passed on the M7 branch.
cd client && pnpm test: 298 passed; pnpm build succeeded on the M7 branch.
PRs #73-#78 each recorded their own tests and screenshots.

reconciliation.evidence: One server catalog (GET /api/metrics/catalog) feeds explorer, report and compare; parity test (PR #75).
Seven stacked PRs: #73 trust fixes through the M7 pilot PR.
Trust (#73), portfolio (#74, #75, M7), Git activity (#76), quality evidence as zero-config findings (#78).
Low Comments, hardcoded/duplicated text and raw TSX counters cut with no compatibility layer (#74); M7 demoted further metrics by evidence.
The agent ran the pilot on four local repos and adjudicated 729 cases (docs/research/metric-pilot-2026-10).
Single-metric Hot Spots list (#75) and the 2x2 scatter view with named quadrants (#77).
Component-scoped React/Solid metrics (#74); M7 kept LOC, hooks, effects, JSX depth and props as defaults, demoted inline handlers and JSX conditionals.
comment_noise replaces the low-comments penalty (#74); TODOs are neutral detail.
Findings run tsc/eslint/ruff/srcly TS rules with no config (#78).
Activity, Blast radius, Component weight, Comment noise and Findings presets (#77, #78); M7 tuned the comment-noise cut-off.
All three rules shipped with absolute thresholds (#74); M7 raised the narrated-code ratio from 0.5 to 1.0 comment lines per code line on pilot evidence, still absolute.
Project tsc/eslint when present, otherwise ruff and srcly's TS rules, labelled by tool (#78).
Landed in the confirmed order #73 → #78 → M7 pilot.

follow_ups: Scope LOC (and commit count) to code languages, so Markdown, HTML and CSS stop ranking beside code.
Make parameter_count's file and folder value the max arity with a witness instead of a sum.
Fix the LOC description or count: TS and Python LOC include comment lines; then revisit comment_ratio.
Weight findings by severity, or set stylistic rules (eslint curly) apart, so one project rule can't fill the Findings preset.
Detect components that return .map(...) of JSX (explorEDA DslCode.tsx).
Run the next pilot on a TS repo without tsc or eslint and a non-author repo, with a second reviewer.
